label: Plaud
description: Trigger on new or updated recordings; read transcripts and summaries, manage devices and uploads

operations.name: list_workspaces
operations.description: Read the workspace belonging to the supplied US workspace token.

operations.name: list_members
operations.description: Read one page of members, including inactive members.

operations.name: list_file_changes
operations.description: Read one page of changed recordings; retain next_checkpoint to resume.

operations.name: get_file_summaries
operations.description: Read all generated summaries for a recording.

operations.name: get_file_audio
operations.description: Get the expiring audio URL, without downloading the audio.

operations.name: get_device_binding
operations.description: Read remote device binding and app history; this does not prove ownership.

operations.name: bind_device
operations.description: Register a device/owner association in the Plaud cloud registry.

operations.name: unbind_device
operations.description: Remove the cloud binding. Also call depair(clear: true) in the device SDK to clear the local BLE binding.

operations.name: generate_presigned_urls
operations.description: Generate multipart upload URLs. Upload the raw chunks separately and keep each ETag.

operations.name: complete_upload
operations.description: Finalize previously uploaded parts. The returned download URL lasts 24 hours.

operations.name: on_new_or_updated_recording
operations.description: Watch the workspace change feed; existing recordings are baselined when armed.
